thread.title: Update: TSX in Triple Digit Decline on Global Growth Worries; Dow Plunges 660 Points

author: MT Newswires
title: Update: TSX in Triple Digit Decline on Global Growth Worries; Dow Plunges 660 Points
text:
Shutterstock photo Canadian markets continued to be swayed by global growth angst, but still managed to outperform Wall Street on Thursday. The S&P/TSX Composite Index was down 134 points or 0.9% to close at 14,212. On Wall Street, the Dow dropped more than 660 points while the Nasdaq was down more than 200 points and the S&P500 lost 62 points.
On the TSX, the tech sector led decliners with a 4% drop on investor concerns about Apple's ( AAPL ) growth. AAPL lost 10% in New York. Materials and financials both dropped about 1%, while the energy sector was off 0.2% even as WTI crude climbed 1.2% to over US$47 per barrel. WTI crude lost 24% in 2018. Gold rose 0.8% today and is only $5.20 away from the $1,300 per ounce mark.
In stock news, heavily traded Aurora Cannabis (ACB.TO) shed 2% while Barrick Gold (ABX.TO) lost 1.5% and HEXO (HEXO.TO) rose 6.5%. In the tech sector, Shopify (SHOP.TO) fell 6.5%.
There were no Canadian economic reports today. Friday brings December jobs reports in both Canada the U.S. The Industrial Product Price Index is also due tomorrow, along with the Raw Material Price Index.
The Canadian dollar rose more than half-a-cent to 74.18 US on stronger oil prices and global growth concerns in the U.S.
